questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: For a car of mass m taking a turn of radius r on a road banked at angle θ, with friction neglected, the correct relation is:
questions.explanation: The horizontal component of the normal reaction supplies the centripetal force while its vertical component balances the weight, and dividing the two gives tan θ = v²/rg.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 4: Laws of Motion

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Sound waves travelling in air are longitudinal because the particles of the medium vibrate:
options: Perpendicular to the direction of propagation
questions.explanation: Air has no shear elasticity, so it cannot carry transverse waves. The compressions and rarefactions of sound are along the direction of travel.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Two long parallel wires carrying currents in the same direction:
options: Exert no force on each other
questions.explanation: Parallel currents attract and antiparallel currents repel, and the force per unit length is μ₀I₁I₂/2πd. This effect is the basis of the definition of the ampere.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 4: Moving Charges and Magnetism

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: Which of the following oxides is amphoteric in nature?
questions.explanation: Aluminium oxide reacts with both acids and alkalis. Across a period the oxides change from basic through amphoteric to acidic.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 3: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Reductive ozonolysis of an alkene is a useful reaction mainly because it:
options: Converts the alkene into an alkane
Locates the position of the double bond from the carbonyl products formed
questions.explanation: The double bond is cleaved and each carbon becomes a carbonyl carbon, so identifying the aldehydes or ketones formed tells you exactly where the double bond was.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Ethylenediaminetetraacetate (EDTA) is described as a hexadentate ligand because it:
options: Binds the metal ion through six donor atoms
questions.explanation: Two nitrogen and four oxygen atoms grip the metal, forming a very stable chelate. This is why EDTA is used to treat lead poisoning and to estimate water hardness.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The members of Chlorophyceae, or green algae, owe their colour mainly to:
questions.explanation: Brown algae are coloured by fucoxanthin and red algae by phycoerythrin, so the dominant pigment is the basis of this classification.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In a eukaryotic mRNA, the non-coding stretches that are removed before translation are called:
questions.explanation: Introns are spliced out and the exons joined to give mature mRNA, so eukaryotic genes are described as split genes. Prokaryotes lack this step.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 5: Molecular Basis of Inheritance

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The movement of food through the human alimentary canal and of mucus in the trachea is brought about by:
questions.explanation: Cilia lining the trachea sweep mucus and dust out, while smooth muscle produces peristalsis in the gut. Amoeboid movement is seen in leucocytes and macrophages.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 17: Locomotion and Movement

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which hormone secreted by the anterior pituitary stimulates the Leydig cells of the testis to secrete androgens?
options: LH, also called ICSH in the male
questions.explanation: LH acts on the interstitial Leydig cells, while FSH acts on the Sertoli cells to support spermatogenesis.
